name: Stephani M.
body: I live in the woods in new jersey, specifically the pine barrens. to say that we have ticks is an understatement. walking through my backyard to add seed to bird feeders results in at LEAST 5 of them visibly crawling on my clothing before i return to the house and who knows how many more that are not obviously visible. I have been bitten well over 20 times in 2026. we also have a variety of ticks. i have seen weird red ones, itty bitty tiny ones that are barely discernable from a freckle, large black ones that swell into weird balloons. even taking the recyc out to the can barely 20 feet away results in multiple ticks. last saturday i went outside and worked in the yard. i cleared all of the ticks i could see off of my clothing, showered and scrubbed down, and still was awakened multiple times overnight to them crawling over me and having to get up and flush them down the drain and in 3 instances, pull them off. the next day, i applied the field balm which had arrived in the mail late the previous day. i coated my arms and legs. I went out in jeans and a tee shirt and worked in the yard again. came back in. no ticks visible on my clothing. showered, no ticks obviously on my person. slept. no ticks awakened me. next morning, dressed. no tick bites visible anywhere i could see. next day, after work i took out the trash and filled a few bird feeders. I did not reapply the field balm   simply because i was curious, given its texture and how it seemed to absorb to find out how long it lasts. no ticks that day either. unfortunately for me, since this is a product i have just gotten and until this point, i have never been someone to routinely apply product to my skin and never just for going outside, the next friday i forgot to reapply when i went to work in the yard and i paid the price. the absence of ticks was not a change in season, but truly due to field balm because they were BACK with a vengeance as soon as i forgot to use it. hopefully i have learned my lesson and will apply daily or at least every other day when i am working outside during the warm months. Thank you for this AWESOME product. it applies nicely, feels good on my skin, and unlike most products that claim to keep pests away, it smells really nice!

I could go on about this amazing F-Balm, but I recommend that people try it for themselves.

body:
I have probably tried over a hundred under eye and face creams due to my extremely sensitive eyes. Yes, they were ‘all natural’, ‘plant based’ and even ‘vegan’!! Before and after picture. No make up, no touch ups, no filter. Just tallow. 🙏

name: Naomi

body: Just received mine a few days ago and absolutely love the product. I'm over 60 and my skin very dry and prone to clogged pores. My face has honestly never felt so good. Soft and dewy. body: I was excited to receive my pkg of F-Balm...it certainly has changed my thinking around how to moisturize., and I love the premise of the company. I've been using it for over a week now, and I can attest that using F-Balm consistently healed a pair of very chapped lips (we live in a "mountain desert" climate) within a couple of days. The only thing I'm having a hard time with is the tacky feel that's coming from the honey, which I know is healthy (and gives it a hint of sweetness, should you happen to taste it!). That's all - my only complaint. Otherwise, thank you for teaching me the powers of using tallow!

name: Tina
body: Ordered both the f-Balm and the peppermint lip balm. I held off doing a review to make sure it wasn’t just a quick response to dry skin. I’m about 4 weeks in now so here’s my thoughts. I’ve been using the balm on my face twice a day. I haven’t used any of my usual eye creams or serums and within days I was seeing a difference. My skin particularly around my eyes (yes I used it under eye as well) looks - I don’t want to say younger but not as wrinkly and sunken in. Overall my skin looks fresher and healthy. I have used expensive brand name products as well as locally made plant derived products and have switched over the years without ever really see a difference from one product to another. I see a difference this time. Not only is there a difference but I’m getting it from ONE product - not a morning and night routine involving multiple steps and products. As far as the lip balm goes - as soon as it slid onto my lips I knew this was something different and I liked it- it slides on and feels like silk but melts right in. I’m the one with multiple tubes of lip balm everywhere and have tried oodles of types with mixed satisfaction. I orders the 3 pack and although I don’t need to keep reapplying like the others I have the tin’s strategically placed around my house now. Finally I feel the need to say I don’t usually do product reviews and I’m sorry if it seems like I’m rambling. You got my attention with your cause- I admit I had to google tallow…and for whatever reason I decided to give it a try. Needless to say I’ll be ordering again soon!

I’ve been using F-Balm for about a month now, and I’m very impressed with the results. It provides excellent hydration and has noticeably helped even out my skin tone. I was pleasantly surprised by how little product is needed for each application; a small amount goes a long way.
The scent is light and pleasant, and it glides on smoothly. While it initially feels rich, it absorbs beautifully into the skin instead of sitting on the surface. Unlike many oils and balms that leave a greasy film, the initial greasiness quickly disappears, leaving my skin feeling soft, hydrated, and comfortable without any heavy residue.
I have very sensitive skin, so I’m always cautious about trying new products. This balm has never caused any breakouts, irritation, discomfort, or rash, which tells me it’s made with high-quality ingredients.
I typically use it at night or on days when I’m not wearing makeup, and I wake up with skin that feels nourished, hydrated, and healthy.
I’ve invested thousands in skincare products over the years, and I can honestly say this has delivered the best results so far while being the most affordable option with the simplest ingredients. It honestly makes me feel duped by the big cosmetic companies after spending so much money on expensive products that never delivered results like this.

body:
F-Balm has been a total game changer for my hockey player's feet!
My son plays hockey and his feet were so dry and cracked they looked like they belonged to an old man. We tried what felt like every foot cream on the market and nothing made a lasting difference.
Someone recommended castor oil because it's a more natural option. At first, it seemed to work really well, but I eventually realized it was causing my son to have explosive diarrhea. As soon as I made the connection, I stopped using it. That experience really drove home how important it is to be mindful of what we put on our skin, especially when it can be absorbed so quickly. I saw ads for F-Balm on Instagram and decided to give it a try because I liked the idea of using beef tallow. I am so glad I did. It has worked wonders on my son's feet. As long as he remembers to use it regularly (and let's be honest, boys don't always remember!), his feet are almost perfect. Seeing him happy to have normal, healthy feet again has been amazing.
I can't thank the makers of F-Balm enough for creating a natural product that actually works. My son definitely isn't giving up hockey anytime soon, so finding something that keeps his feet healthy has been a game changer. Since then, I've also started using the Face Whip and love it. I recently ordered another tin of F-Balm for my son, but my daughter claimed she deserved one too! Now I find myself sneaking a little from her tin to refill his empty one, while trying to make it last as long as possible. Needless to say, F-Balm has become a household favorite. It's one of those rare products that actually lives up to the hype and I recommend it without hesitation.

I can’t wait to share this with more of my friends and family and be a returning customer. I have gotten so many compliments on my skin since using this it’s amazing. My cuticles were cracked and bleeding but the F-Balm has really helped. All products are easy to apply after some getting use to. I highly recommend this product. I love that it’s Canadian made.

name: Claudia N.
body: I absolutely LOVE this product!! It is lighter than the F-Balm which I also love. I use the whipped on my face and neck. My skin feels AMAZING! And I can definitely tell the difference. I noticed an overnight difference in my lines and wrinkles. I will be reordering!!! 💖

name: Colleen P.
body:
This product is amazing.  I have dry skin and nothing was helping it. I was going to resort to medicated cream from my doctor.
I gave this a try and my goodness what a change my skin transformed in a month to soft and supple.
I will be purchasing this product for life

name: Andy C.
body: I'm a 59 Y/O Male who has had this acne condition which can sometimes create awful scars when I felt one coming up on my face I started use F-balm a long with the medication which clears the issue but not the scarring.  This miraculously took the swelling down and prevented the scar tissue.  Then I was using a topical medication on my head which was causing pain and itching on my head this completely healed it.  It is a great moisturizer that seems not to bother my skin like other products.  It is fantastic and I will keep using it on my scalp and face and hands, and anywhere else it will help.  Love it!

name: Francine S.
body:
I have been using the unscented F-balm for about 2 weeks now. I must say my skin does look radiant. I had some invisible bumps on both sides of the outer part of my face forever and they seem to have disappeared. Too soon to say anything about my fine lines. I do not have many but would like to sèe them disappear as well.
The scent is tolerable and disappears after a few minutes.  I will give a follow up at a later time on those fine lines and will continuously use it bc my skin does look nice and I like not adding harmful ingredients to my skin.

name: Miranda R.
body: I purchased each of my sons a tin of F-balm. Both struggle a little with acne and mild skin irritation in sweaty zones. I wanted something that was super easy for them to use just getting out of the shower as skin regimens would definitely be a waste of money….I've tried and they can’t be bothered. Both boys are saying they really like the F-balm and how it makes their skin feel. The scent is also quite nice. It’s a bit too soon to see a big difference with acne but we’re sticking with it. Thank you for standing up for freedom and for speaking truth unapologetically. This world needs more sense (because it’s not common anymore). Keep up the good work and thank you for your amazing products. Can’t wait to see what happens!

name: Tammy H.
body: Been using it for a week.  Love the way my skin feels.  Also, I was dealing with very dry skin behind my ear lobes so I’ve been applying F-Balm to those areas and the dry cracked skin is healed.  A little goes a long way.  Trying to get the teenager to use it for his acne (the original reason I purchased it 🙄) we will see if he heeds my advice!! Thanks for a great product.  I’ll report back in a month or so!

name: Dawn M.
body: I’m 62 years old and have been using the f balm everyday for the past 2 weeks. I’ve noticed an extraordinary difference in the moisture level of my skin as well as an evening of my complexion! I’m hooked!!! I will continue to use this magical balm everyday! If you’re on the fence, go ahead and order 2 (a much better deal) and enter the life with moisturized facial skin with a dramatic improvement in your complexion!!

name: Beverly P.
body: I would definitely recommend this product. Very hesitant at first to order it; but after a few uses I noticed my  face is so soft. I also use this product on my feet ,which were very dry , it has  made a difference in less than a week… and I love that this is a Canadian product.

name: Annabelle L.
body: I used to buy expensive brand moisturizer. And then I saw the Tallowed Truth F-Balm.  I bought it out of curiousity.  Will this product keep my skin moisturize? I am 63 years old and keeping my skin moisturize is my main priority.  True to its advertisement, my skin is soft and pores are smaller after one month of use.  I gave one of the tins to my stepmom and she too love the F-Balm.  I will continue to use this product and recommend it to friends and family!

name: Tracey P.
body: I very rarely write reviews, but after using this product for a few weeks, I felt it was important to share my experience. I am amazed by the quality of this tallow. I did a lot of research before purchasing and this company stands for so many things that I value. I was happy to spend a little more to support a business with such integrity. It is an added bonus that the product is phenomenal! Even my 12-year-old daughter will use it on her lips and hands during these cold winter months. This is the first winter her lips are not chapped. There is no offensive smell and both my hands and lips are better for this! I have our whole family using this tallow and we plan be customers for life.

name: Andrea C.
body:
This product is amazing. My skin hasn’t been smoother or softer in years!  As winter drys out my skin, this has been a game changer for me.  I have had people ask me what is my skin care routine…they say it is glowing. Not to mention, make up goes on WAY easier and blends into my skin as if it isn’t even there.
I had cancer surgery and I have a horrible scar and it has help with the healing of it. The area was very dry and flaky…not anymore thanks to The Tallow Truth 🙏🏻

name: Mary G.
body:
I've had psoriasis since infancy. I've tried every prescription medication, diet, supplement, and every home remedy and old wives tale out there. Five weeks of using F-Balm and my psoriasis on my back - and everywhere else - is almost completely gone. My skin feels great. I'm a customer for life for this reason alone.
When I first started using F-Balm I thought it was making my skin drier, but I persisted and realized it was just highlighting how thirsty my skin was for real moisture.   Chemical laden moisturizers had been camouflaging the dry condition of my skin.
Love this company and their products!

name: Kim W.
body:
First, let me thank you again for sending out a replacement immediately.  I was pleasantly surprised with your service.
I went through chemo from June 2025-Dec 2025 and my skin, especially on my face wreaked havoc.  I have tried everything and nothing smooths the deep wrinkles/lines.  I have only used your product now for about 10 days and can definitely see a difference in my skins appearance in this short time.  I am hoping to see continued results :-)  Kim Williams

name: Nathalie L.
body:
I have been using the Freedom Face Whip for only a week and I have noticed a big difference already. The fine lines have diminished, my skin feels hydrated and smooth. I absolutely love the product.
I used to purchase expensive products that didn’t provide half the benefits of this product. I strongly recommend it especially if you have to endure the cold Canadian winters.

name: Karen W.
body:
I love this product it feels so good on my face and I’ve already noticed a difference after only a few days using the freedom face whip. I bought the summer scent feels like I just stepped out of the spa
Karen Wade
54 years old
Victoria BC

name: Karen W.
body:
I love this product it feels so good on my face and I’ve already noticed a difference after only a few days using the freedom face whip. I bought the summer scent feels like I just stepped out of the spa

name: Zackery M.
body:
Im a construction worker. I used to not care what type of soap I used as long as it cleaned me off. After years of terrible product and dry skin, I finally decided Ive had enough chemicals on me for life. The Tallowed Truth caught me attention not only because of its simplicity, but the some of the ads were comedic and captivating.
Not expecting any huge difference, I recieved the order and began using this soap. I was blown away, my skin no longer itched, it washed clean away, easily, without having to turn the water hot enough that it rivals a fresh flow of magma straight from the earth. I smelled amazing, which can be a task after some days in my industry. I literally look forward to using this soap, which I found to be quite odd as Ive never had a yearning to use a soap before. But here we are. Thanks again and I'll be a lifelong customer.

name: Justin B.
body:
I have sensitive and oily skin and use a lot of expensive products to keep it under control along with redness.
I came across F-Balm via social media and Ben's unfiltered marketing and promotion of his product really captivated me.
So, I've been using F-Balm for the past week and I am pleasantly surprised on how it has impacted the skin on my face. It's soft, clear and my oily skin is gone, which is funny since I'm using beef tallow on my face! I would have thought it would have made it more oily. I just apply some F-Balm after washing my face and just go about my day.
Thank you Ben for introducing me to such a wonderful skin-care product.
I'm excited to try the Freedom Face Whip and S-Balm next!

name: Jennifer H.
body: The best!! Ordered one tin to try as my nighttime skincare regimen, I gave crazy sensitive skin and has been using cold pressed olive oil for years as my go to for moisturizer..the results first morning were amazing and decided to have this be my morning and night regimen. After a week, texture and rough spots drastically improved, sun spots almost completely faded..ordered 2 more tins so I can have a replacement ready and one to travel with daily. Great for lips also.

name: Tiana-karissa S.
body: I have been using this product for several months now.  As I approach 50 I have been noticing fine lines around my eyes and face. This products has minimized and rehydrated my face well.  I only use natural products but this far out shines anything I have used to date including other small batch tallow rendered creams.  So much so my teenage daughter thought she try it out on some problem spots and she is absolutely in love with it as well.  It seems to serve over a large range of skin types given our difference in age.  The quality products that are used are very evident and they seem to be very fresh.  I have bought well made natural products only to find they go bad extremely quickly.  Not so with F-balm products.  And I love what they stand for which is an extra bonus!

name: Connie Y.
body:
The texture is incredibly rich and smooth, and the scent is grounding without being overpowering. It’s rare to find a product that feels this high-quality and "clean" while actually delivering results on dry or sensitive skin.
I had a specific issue with a sensitivity, and the customer service team (Thank you to Shantel 💖）handled it with a level of kindness and generosity that is almost unheard of these days. They truly went above and beyond to make sure I was taken care of, proving that they value their customers' well-being more than just making a sale.
It is so refreshing to support a business that creates a stellar product and backs it up with such genuine care. If you’re looking for a holy grail tallow balm from a company you can trust, this is it!

name: Sarah H.
body: I’ve only been using F-Balm for about 10 days. So far it’s been amazing. I had several severely dry flaky patches on my nose, cheeks, and neck. My dermatologist was having me use Aquaphor and Vaseline - these were helping somewhat. However, my dry patches have all but disappeared in the last 10 days. A little goes a long way & I make sure my skin is damp when applying.

name: Liz R.
body:
I apologize as this review is way past due but I love everything this company stands for and so thankful that I discovered them (courtesy of Instagram).
The timing was impeccable as I had developed a skin irritation to my usual hand soap. My hands cleared up so fast after trying the F-Balm followed by the Tallowed Truth Bar.
I will never deviate from this brand as everything else that I’ve tried had been perfect as well. Including the F-balm lip balm, freedom face whip, body balm & sunblock.
I just purchased the Freedom Field Balm so will definitely be testing that once venturing outdoors 😎
Did I mention that their customer service is also amazing as I had to contact them when the carrier had delivered to someone else’s community mailbox in error. Anastasia promptly worked to have a replacement package sent (since the people who had received my mail opted to keep it for themselves 😑…hopefully they became customers as well)
I proudly wear the caps and look forward to new merchandise + products 😊
Thank you all so much!! ❤️

body: My husband had a huge patch (elbow to wrist) of plaque which was growing larger at the time I ordered our first F-Balm. He started applying it and within six weeks or so the patches cleared, leaving just a red area. Since then, as you can see in the photo, even most of the redness has faded! I’m using F-Balm as well and LOVE the scent of the outdoor balm. I ordered more during your latest sale (thank you) and I intend to share with friends and family. Thanks for an amazing, Canadian, excellent product, Ben!!

name: Nicole M.
body: We are constantly in the woods, fields, parks and am very conscious of the reported increase in ticks, so, being a HUGE FAN of all Tallowed Truth products, had to try this...and it didn't disappoint!  The smell is excellent.  I used on all exposed skin areas, especially around ankles and calves, by my ears and neck....not a bite, not a tick, mosquito or otherwise!  And my skin just loves the tallow formula base.  Well done once again and many thanks to Ben and team!  You are producing super products that I can't stop sharing and recommending to others.  It makes me so happy when someone starts using Tallowed Truth balms and whips and then they too become believers....because they see and feel the amazing difference!  Keep up the good work!!  And thanks again! - nic

name: Tracy H.
body:
Absolutely love the F Balm. I use it on my face, body and lips. It cleared up a recurring patchy rash on my face which I had for over a year within 2 weeks of use.
My husband’s dermatologist asked him what he had been using on his face because his skin looked so great!

name: Stephanie J.
body: I am 71 years old and have had skin cancer on my face removed a couple times - those areas have been rough,scaly and dry - started putting f balm on those areas and with in a week now my skin looks and feels so much better - one place near my hairline was even raised and had an area that was darkened - it fell off yesterday!! I have a similar area on my leg- although much larger it is decreasing in size - I put the balm on faithfully every morning and night / luv it!!

name: Sandi S.
body:
This is the second time i have ordered products  from this company! The speed of service is incredible.!  I believe I received it by the next day. I no longer spend money on numerous products for my daily routine. Honestly I dont have the time. F- Balm is my favorite,  but i do use the the whipped one at bedtime. We have a farm so ticks are always an issue. I ordered the Field Balm. I used it for my face and neck. Will have to try if for a while to let you know if we have any success! Ben, I  was hoping to see the package deal come up again.  Any chance of that happening 😉?
For anyone who is unsure, It's a great product, competitively priced , and a great way to support Canadians hard at work! Thanks guys!

name: Michelle C.
body: I love the body butter!  I just ordered it for the first time during the 4th of July sale, why did I wait soooo long?  I have seen the fine lines, craping skin by my knees disappear!  I knew the regular F-Balm has done wonders for my face and hands, but I wasn't expecting the body butter to work so quickly!  I am 55 and I am outside and moving my body all the time, so to have a product that works, and is 100% natural is even better!  I highly recommend!

name: Kimberly S.
body: Love love love this, I am 66 years old, I’ve been using creams for many years now and by far this is the best thing I’ve ever used, I noticed a difference within a few days if using it, only thing I wish is for it to smell nicer

name: Lori S.
body:
I was pretty skeptical after trying so many products in the past with little to no results, but the Tallowed Truth Face Whip has been incredible.
The lines on my face have noticeably diminished in as little as three weeks! My skin looks bright, even, and dewy—my family has even commented on the difference. I love knowing that what I’m putting on my face is made with clean, non-toxic ingredients.
I’m so thrilled with the results that I’ve already purchased the body butter to help with crepey skin on my arms and legs. Thank you, Ben, at Tallowed Truth! I am so glad I gave your product a try.

name: Monica W.
body: I've been using it on a callus on the bottom of my big toe, previously quite painful, but no more! It softened the skin and is almost entirely gone. The dry patches on my hands have softened considerably also. It also took away the itch from a deer fly bite in a couple of days. I react badly to such bites and they typically form a large itchy scab that remains for a good week.  What a relief. Good stuff!! Give it a try.

name: Kelly
body: The F-bomb is amazing. I can see a difference in my hands within 2 days of use. My face is soft and has a glow to it now . I ordered 3 tins of the regular f-bomb and don’t care for the smell so when I reorder I will try the scented F-bomb. I have recommended the product to many and I am excited to see their results as well . This is the only product I will ever put on my skin

name: Katie M.
body: ex vegan of 5 yers and have struggled with hormonal acne for like ever. this made a HUGE difference. people were coming up to me left and right, saying that I look so healthy, im glowing, and WOW your skin! love it. originally bought to support the pro freedom but turned out better than expected!

name: Anna
body: It was the non-PC marketing that caught my attention… Well done! But it was the all natural ingredients that got me to buy it… Well done again! I had excessively dry and cracking patches of eczema in between my fingers, as well as large itchy patches of eczema all over my body. With four young children, two still in diapers, there is no use trying to reapply throughout the day. But just using it before I went to bed for two night transformed my hands! It's also making a huge difference for the other eczema patches when I remember to use it 😅. Thank you for this really great product!

name: Michael
body:
I am 56 and have rosacea that flairs up from time to time. I've been in a recent (long) flare-up and the prescription medicine just was making my skin dry, but not relieving the bumps and redness. I figured I had nothing to lose by ordering some snake oil that said it was natural.
I've been so impressed! My flare-up has subsided and my skin feels softer. I had a few rough patches on my cheeks that have softened.
I'm a believer and plan to buy more when my first tin runs out. But if you ever cave and add crap to this stuff...I'm out!

name: Cris
body:
So a coworker introduced me to this stuff. I started using it as soon as I got it in the mail . I’ve tried several other products as I have sensitive skin for one thing and secondly I’m going through menopause and I’m experiencing very dry skin.
It’s now day 4 since I started using it and I really see a difference compared to other products I’ve purchased. I can tell right away if it’s going to work for me or not. So far I am pleased that it’s keeping my skin hydrated and moisturized. It doesn’t clog my pores nor irritate my skin. I’m looking forward to the anti aging benefits.

name: Kristen E.
body:
I've tried all of The Tallowed Truth's products, including the lavender soap, lip balm and butters and I've honestly liked every one of them. I also love that it's a Canadian company and that the products are made with tallow.
Since I started using their products, my skin feels much softer and smoother. I've noticed my skin looks healthier and more hydrated too, which is a huge plus.
My favourite product is definitely the new Bee Free Vanilla Body Butter. It smells SO good. The vanilla scent is warm and comforting, and the smell actually lasts for a long time after you put it on. I find myself smelling my hands and arms throughout the day because it smells that nice!
It also absorbs really well and doesn't leave my skin feeling greasy or sticky. My skin just feels soft and moisturized.
I've also had great experiences with their customer service. They're friendly, easy to deal with, and quick to help if you have a question.
I'll definitely keep buying from The Tallowed Truth. I trust their products, I love the ingredients they use, and I've always been happy with everything I've purchased from them.

name: Stacey W.
body: The vanilla body butter is the third product I have purchased from your awesome company! While I was checking out I took advantage of the half off F bomb and purchased my second tin 👍 the vanilla body butter is lovely! Smells great, very smooth and soaks in quickly! I love it, but not surprised as the other two products I have (F bomb scented and whipped face cream also scented) are great!! Keep up the great work!! I love that the company is located in my province and that they use Canadian ingredients, I love what they stand for and I love how they’re down to earth, the real deal! I enjoy the emails and seeing videos on Instagram!! I am 55 yrs old, I really feel like the products are helping me with the endless fight against menopause and the havoc it’s wreaking on my skin!!! I’m sure all the ladies at my age can relate lol!

Keep up the great work please! I need you!

name: Karen B.
body:
I’m not into sharing pictures.  But……..
I had this age wrinkle on the left side of my face, that I took a picture of before I started using your product.   It’s diminishing, day by day.  I’ve actually had people ask me why I’m not aging, and where am I hiding my wrinkles.
I’m 65 this year.   Trust me, I am not anyone’s next door, hot older neighbour. I’m not, that.  Might be fun though.  But I’m feeling pretty darn good since trying a truth based cream.
100% credit to F-Balm and the face whip.
Stop paying for pharmaceutical products with ingredients you can’t pronounce bathed in a high water solution.  You’re paying a ridiculous amount of money for water! WATER! Why would anyone be ok doing that?
May I say I love that this product is all natural, and  not full of chemical ingredients, I can’t even pronounce.
Check out ‘the truth’
Truth is Truth.

body:
I absolutely love all my Tallowed Truth products & use them twice daily.  I especially love the vanilla scented body butter.
I have a suggestion:  I know your business is fairly new, & you are constantly developing new products.   But one product that a lot of today’s women could really benefit from is a product for spider & varicose veins.  If you could add horse nut, plus something else for circulation, I would be excited to try it out.  Having worked on hard or cement floors all my life, I have to choose wisely with what clothes I wear to keep my ugly veins covered.  Just a suggestion…….,
Overall, I cannot say enough positive comments about Tallowed Truth.  Keep up the fantastic work!!

body:

name: Sandra M.
body: I previously started using a grass fed tallow.  I was happy with the results.  But before that I exclusively only used organic unrefined rosehip oil that I would add frankincense to.  You see I have MCS which means I’m allergic or have an intolerance to most things not in their natural state and chemicals of all sorts.   Anyway I missed my frankincense which is why I decided to try yours.  As soon as I got it I applied it to my face and was disappointed because it felt sticky on my skin.  Then I read the instructions and tried it again the next day.  I hadn’t wet my skin first and had used too much.  So now I am very pleased with it.  Then I tried it on other parts of my body.  I’m 72 and came from the generation of sun worshippers who would apply baby oil and fry ourselves in the hot sun to tan.  Never used sunscreen.  So my arms and upper chest area have creepy skin.  So I decided to try to apply it there too.  I was blown away. It totally plumped up my skin immediately in front of my eyes on my arms and it lasted all day. I feel confident enough to wear sleeveless tops now. I also use it a couple times a day on my hands.  I’m a full time caregiver and wash my hands a lot.   I only gave it 4 stars because of the price for such a tiny amount.  But then again I’m using much less than the previous one I was using.  Also the rosehip oil stained my bed sheets and I’m not sure yet if this will too by looking at the color of it.

I would definitely recommend you give this a try.

body:
I’m a sucker for a gimmick. Let’s just say I’m ever hopeful, but am used to being disappointed.
After a year of Retinol, not seeing results and just having sore skin and chapped lips as a side effect, I went back to my basic routine of Cera Ve.
Fell in love with Tallowed Truth bc of the posts and strong stance on their convictions (backtracking apologies are overrated), I forked over the most I’ve ever paid for a lotion.
3 weeks of use and I don’t know what it is, but I do know I look in the mirror and think … “there’s something different”. Idk if it’s a more even tone, or lines are smoother… ? I didn’t take before pictures bc I’m a natural pessimist- so I can’t tell ya, but I’m happy with it and would more easily hand over another $40.
The consistency is different, so that was something to get used to. It does give a more dewy look. I don’t mix too much water with it like it says you can. A lot does go a long way and the smell is very mild which I appreciate. No beefy smell some have complained about. 3 weeks in and I’ve barely touched the surface so I do think this will last a bit.
Overall, I’m loving the journey!

I'm sure the peppermint oil is nice for many people but for me and some others, it's an irritant and causes redness and a burning sensation. Just a suggestion,  please 🙏 give it some thought.

For the face, this balm is 100% a good solution. It smells good, feels good, and looks good.

name: William J.
body: I am so impressed with F Balm. I cannot believe the difference in my skin. I use it morning and night on my face. I am 72 years old and have always had issues with my skin and have not had any issues with it since I started using it 3 months ago. I am just amazed. I would love to use it on my whole body but it's a little expensive to be able to do that. Keep up the great work. I LOVE IT. I also use it on my husband's face.

name: Marie H.
body: I like this product.  As the comments suggest, use it sparingly to avoid a greasy feeling.  It spreads quite well.  You really don't need much.  I have found that my tiny wrinkles (I'm 66) disappear.  My skin feels a little more silky.  I use it only in the morning after a shower.  And it does go on better with slightly moist skin.  All good things, except one that I disagree with.  I do smell beef as I apply the product; however, once I start working it in, undertones of honey take over.

name: Heather M.
body:
As much as I hate to admit it, I have mature skin (I’ll be 60 in a few months) Yikes!
I love F-balm, and use it twice a day.
I have sensitive skin and The Tallowed Truth (f-balm) rescued me after a very bad reaction to a “medical grade” 7-step regime that I had started in preparation for my daughter’s wedding this past summer.
My other favourite product is S-balm. It is the only sunscreen I will ever use. I came back from Huatulco, MX with a golden tan..no burn whatsoever.
Thank you for these all-natural products that work so well!!
Heather from Calgary

name: Phyllis S.
body: I like supporting local businesses that provide trustworthy products.  I enjoy reading your random humour plus the stories of encouragement to use natural products.  I’m happy with my recent purchase of The Freedom Facewhip, the light consistency is great.  I noticed my face looked more pleasant in the mornings after applying it at night.  It’s a quick and easy application process and will be great for long bike rides and boat rides, with maybe a little of your zinc product on the side when need be this summer.  I’ve been using your Body Butter products for a couple years now and won’t use anything else.  There is a peace of mind when using your tallow products at my young age of 67 :)

name: Tammy W.
body: Received mine quite quickly in the mail, I started using it right away. I already noticed my skin is softer. I have a glow to my face and neck in which I will now be applying the tallow to my legs as they get quite dry in the summer months. I love this product and I love the quality of it. A little goes a long way it’s definitely a great motto for this product. My children also swear by beef tallow, my one son has made the switch to F bomb and I’m pretty sure my other three will get on board. I will purchase again.

name: Laura N.
body: This product took some getting used to. When I first put it on I scooped the same amount that I would use if applying face cream. Too much! It absorbed really well but I found it a little smelly and considered returning it. However, I really like how it made my skin feel so I decided to try again with a little less Now I don’t notice the smell except maybe the first couple of minutes. But the smoothness of my skin and the fact the I no longer have dry flaky patches around my mouth and chin has me really loving this product. I’m so glad I gave it a second chance.

name: Juanita H.
body: I love F-Balm and for what the company stands for!  It’s very moisturizing and it makes my skin feel so smooth.  At 69, I get compliments from people who say I don’t have wrinkles and of course, that’s appreciated.  I’m a forever customer and love that it’s a product made in my home country of Canada!  People should try it!  Money back guaranteed if you don’t like it, too!

name: Julie B.
body: I’ve been using tallow on my face for a short time and I’m honestly surprised at how quickly I noticed a difference. My skin feels softer, more hydrated, and looks healthier overall. Dry spots and irritation calmed down fast, and my complexion already looks smoother and more balanced. I love that it’s simple, natural, and doesn’t leave my skin feeling greasy. Definitely becoming a staple in my skincare routine.

name: Caroll F.
body:
I have been using another brand of tallow for the last couple of years.  Every once in a while I will try a new brand. That is what I did here.  I am 61 and could see a difference in the first couple of days.  You win.
I am not fond of the initial smell when I put it on but it dissipates very quickly.  I even added more of my own frankincense.
Please do not ever sell out to a big company.  I love this stuff.

name: Paolo M.
body:
The experiment/Tallow Balm worked...
The plan was to quietly start using F-Balm, not say a word to anyone, and see if anyone noticed a change.
This past week, I caught my wife staring at me on a few different occasions, making comments, you look hot? lol, soft, bright, younger...I was only 10 days in!? She confronted me and wanted to know what I was doing different. Explained Tallow Balm to her, and sure enough, caught her in my Tallow Balm tin later that night...lucky for me I ordered two, so I gave her one.

name: Anne Y.
body: In a short length of time I have experienced very good results. Firmer skin, wrinkles less visible and "turkey" neck disappearing. I am 76 and have tsken care of my skin for a long time, but F-Balm has truly surprised me. I am so very pleased.

name: Meagan H.
body: Love this stuff. As a 40 year mom to a 3 yr old and a 8 month old I feel like I look pretty jagged mort days. At least with f balm my skin never looks its age! I have super dry skin! I use just a bit on my face and neck at night and fine lines and wrinkles almost disappear overnight!

name: Esther M.
body: I originally bought if for myself and had been using it for about 2 weeks when my daughter came over with her family for a BBQ. She started telling me about the  contact dermatitis that my 18 month old granddaughter had. I gave her my container of F-Balm. After just a few days it started going away. Now, 2 weeks later it's completely gone and a d they've stopped putting it on her.

name: Karen K.
body: I’m very pleased with the efficacy of the Freedom Field Balm. I volunteer for the Couchiching Conservancy to monitor frogs. This entails visiting a swamp within a forest to count and identify frogs for an hour after the sunsets. As you can imagine the mosquitoes are numerous and aggressive. I wear a bug suit but my hands are uncovered so I can take notes. Usually, despite bug spray and the bug suit, I get many bites. This last time I used only Freedom Field balm on my hands, wrists, face, neck and ankles ( and no spray) and I did not get a single mosquito bite or tick bite. I will certainly rely on this balm any time I spend time outside this summer!

name: Karla H.
body: I love the way my skin looks and feels.  I'm 65 and as most women my age wrinkles are inevitable.   I lost 75 pounds and chose to keep off the weight and deal with the wrinkled skin.  I've been using F-Balm for 6 months.   Wrinkles are not gone but have diminished greatly.  Who knows maybe it will keep getting better.  Stay tuned!

name: Robyn M.
body: Was concerned about the scent being too heavy.  My nose detects the lemon eucalyptus and lemon grass scent.  That said, it doesn't linger long enough to be off-putting for me and it has kept insects and bugs at bay since I started using it.  I live in a wild, rural area and have been accosted this summer by ticks, mosquitos and even wasps--I recently purchased the Field Balm to defend myself.  It spreads very easily and I only use a little bit on exposed skin to impart the scent.  Later after the first day, I noticed my skin was SO soft!  My skin loves it as much or more than the other tallow products.  The Field Balm spreads easier and lighter than all their other products and I love it.   I hope they make more with the same texture and feel.  Would love something with a nice lavender scent just for general use.

The ticks up here are insane every year, and seem to procreate like rabbits! I've been using the Field Balm on my lower legs and ankles, as well as the backs of my arms and my neck. So far, I haven't had any issues with ticks, and the mosquitoes (which in the Ottawa Valley are the size of dragonflies) 🤣 have been keeping their distance. This product smells so fresh and summery, but the bugs hate it! 100% recommend!
our_reply: Hi Trish, we're so happy to hear the Freedom Field Balm has kept the bugs at bay during your trip! It sounds like the ticks multiple quickly and mosquitos are huge. Thanks for sharing your experience and for recommending us. Stay safe and enjoy your summer adventures! Appreciate you :)

name: Flordeliza S.
body:
Effective for Hives
I have been using this product the first time I saw it in social media. I used it first for dry skin as it immediately soften my skin. Then lately, I experienced a terrible hives all over my body most especially on my arms and legs. I immediately applied it before bed and when I woke up the hives were gone. I gave the other jar to my son whose experiencing flaky skin on the face. Thank you for the natural ingredients. Just loved it.

name: Stefani C.
body: Amazing product. All I can say is wow! Absolutely love the fact that even after just six days, my skin looks nourished and hydrated. I know I have a way to go, but this is a great start. Unlike chemical laden store-bought products, I use your F bomb at night and whipped face tallow in the mornings with absolutely no problems. No burning, no turning red, no itching and no breaking out. I am a tallow girl at heart so finding a company that not only believes in clean ingredients that our skin understands, you believing in freedom and not being afraid to stand up for it is just an extra bonus. Thank you! I cannot wait to try the rest of your line of products.

name: Kathryn S.
body: I believe i can see quite a difference in my face. I glow more amd lines are already beginning to decrease. I turn 70 on Sept 27th and would love to look much younger by then!!

name: Jake S.
body: Great product,   this was my second time order thr original F bomb.  I was only going to purchase the new Orange and vanilla F bomb but at the checkout it gave me the option of getting the original 50% so naturally going to take advantage of that deal.   I use it on my face around my eyes, nose and forehead and it keeps my skin hydrated and looking younger.  At 48 I need any advantage to not look my age.  Great products and a non woke company,    I love it!

name: Heather L.
body:
I’ve been using F-Balm for about 8 months now and absolutely love what it does for my skin. It keeps my skin soft and moisturized and gives it such a healthy glow. I’ve received so many compliments on my skin since I started using it. I have a tin in each bathroom and another in my purse because I use it that often.
I wasn’t sure about the Orange & Vanilla because I’m not usually a fan of vanilla scents, but I was pleasantly surprised. It’s warm and subtle without being overly sweet, and I can still smell it on my skin hours later. I’ll definitely be repurchasing this one.
I’m also happy to support a Canadian brand that values quality ingredients, keeps things simple, and isn’t afraid to challenge the norms of the beauty industry. Finding a product that works this well is one thing, finding a company whose values align with your own is another.

name: Heather L.
body:
I’ve been using the F Balm for only 2 weeks and I’m quite impressed with how it has improved the dry skin on my legs and feet.
As well I have also noticed an improvement in the red patches on my cheeks with an evening out of my complexion, accomplished in that short space of time.
It’s got my very positive recommendation.

name: Denise
body: I have only been using this for 8 days now but already see a significant improvement in dry patches on my face as well as a nice glow to my skin. I find it is great under makeup - almost like a primer except it makes my face glow! Very happy so far and am anxious to see if in a few weeks it helps reduce my fine lines as well!

name: Joan
body: I have only been using This product for a couple of weeks.  At first, I didn’t think it was really doing anything.  However, just these last few days I have noticed a difference.  I had deep wrinkles and it appears as though they are slowly being diminished.  I intend to keep using it.  I love how my skin feels and my granddaughter says she doesn’t see my wrinkles, just mature skin. That’s a good thing in my books.

name: Maegan B.
body: Came across an ad for this and thought I’d give it a try. Sooooo happy I did!!! I’ve ordered the regular F-balm and lip balm and loved everything so went back and ordered more to give away as gifts and the whipped balm for myself. I’m putting it under and around my eyes at night and my skin looks awesome. Also my hands are in love. They look awesome, no longer crepey. Will be ordering this stuff and recommending as long as it’s available. In love !!

name: Jensyn
body: I use this for everything. I started using it for my baby’s diaper rash (which immediately took it away) and then I had to buy more to start using for my face and it cleared up my acne OVERNIGHT. Shit is magic. Plus I love what the company stands for!

name: Michelle
body: I’m shocked at how well this moisturizes - lips, cuticles, elbows, heels, cheeks, all my kiddo’s boo-boos, etc, etc. I put it on before bed and have plump, supple, soft skin in the morning wherever it was applied. I will need a bulk order next time! So happy I found this clean, natural product. Thank you Ben for starting this movement and for everything you, your products and company stand for. I’m sharing with all my family and friends. FREEDOM!!!

name: Oksana
body: I have been using F-Balm on my face and neck for about two weeks. My skin is very dry and requires hydration after every exposure to water. It's worth noting that I always apply glycerin on my wet skin after any cream to seal the moisture as when I don't do it, my face immediately dries up and becomes itchy and tight. With F-Balm, I am able to skip glycerin, and my skin still feels comfortably soft and hydrated. Applying the balm may be tedious as it does not spread easily until it warms up on your skin. One way to make application easier is to hold a pinch of balm between your fingers to soften it before spreading.

body: I like the company and the man behind it. It has been surprising very good to my face. I have a terribly prone to acne skin that is super dry from my treatments and I took a chance and tried it. I was skeptical, but it didn’t make me break out and it really helped with my skin! I’m worried about the beeswax but I heard he’s making some stuff without it soon and I’m excited to try that! The fragrance isn’t the best. It has a nice slightly sweet and herbal scent that isn’t overpowering. I was scared that it was gonna smell like beef but it doesn’t! Also the brand’s message and what it stands for is an added bonus! Feels nice to be supporting something that matters! Shipping was quick. Nothing negative to say. Thank you Ben and your team, keep up the hard work!

name: Sondra C.
body: This is my first time ever using tallow but always steer towards natural products. I am 67 and have always taken care of my skin. I have definitely noticed a difference in minimizing the lines in my face and softens the skin. Am going to order some now for my husband.

name: Leah
body: I absolutely love this stuff and I can't wait to use it every morning and evening and anytime I think of it throughout the day. My skin is clear. Blemishes and red spots healed and fading quickly. Fine lines are smoothed out! It also works really well with my makeup. My face doesn't get greasy and shiny by the end of the day like it used to. Also used to have redness near my nose and mouth that is gone! Just buy it, give it a try. :)

name: Shantel C.
themes: dry-skin acne scars-healing replaced-expensive men service
body: The whole experience was fantastic. From the second I purchased one tin, it promoted me to buy another for $20, and with a deal like that, how could I not! So smart. I received updates on shipping every day. When it came, I used it immediately. It’s only been 10 days and I’m telling you, I’ve never had a better product. I threw out 98% of my toxic skin care already and ain’t looking back. My previously oily but dry skin is stunning. So so nice!!!!! Lastly, my boyfriend gets awful acne on his back (think boils) and it’s already healing them all. Wowwwwwww. Animal-based products and food for the win!!!! Thanks guys!

name: Beth D.
body: This product is a true gift when it comes to burns. My husband burnt his hand after grabbing the handle of the thermometer he had in the oven for our meat. He put this cream on and the pain disappeared within 15 minutes. Totally healed up after only a few applications. We have used it in several similar situations and it has been such a blessing.

name: Mary M.
body:
I really like this company-they are very attentive.
The F-Balm is one of the best creams and balms I have ever used. It truly does make my skin very soft and not dry at all, but also not greasy! I first got it for my lips because they have been dry for too long. They are getting better. Now I also use it on my face and any skin problem. It soothed a recent burn on my finger and healed it up quickly.
It lives up to the description!

name: Elizabeth L.
body: I am on my second tin. I took a leap of faith and ditched my over the counter anti aging creams. Your product has been a blessing to my face and hands. I have had a dry spot on my left left for over 10 years..no color to it...just dry...now it is almost gone. I started using it on my hubby's feet a week ago. He is retired from USMC and he has alot of dry areas on his feet. He is really happy that they are going away! Thank you!!!!

name: Tim T.
body: My wife instantly saw a difference in the crepey skin on her neck so she had me place a bulk order. We shared with my 80yr old mother in law and she had the same experience. It is useful on the feet and hands as well…..

name: Brenda V.
body: Hi, at 68 years old I just was hesitant to put something on my face the consistency of Vaseline.  I have had acne and  blackheads since I was 13.  I was very surprised and happy with the results.  I have raved about it to many people.  Especially when I get compliments on my skin, for my age!!!  That is always nice to hear.  Thanks Brenda Vaughan

name: Matthew L.
body: When I first started using Fbalm I had enlarged pores, crows feet, and wrinkles. Since I have been using this product I’ve noticed a huge transformation in my skin, it’s like I’m in y twenties again, and I’ll be 44 next month. Very satisfied with this product, and no way I will stop using it!!!

name: Mindy D.
body: My face no longer has dry skin and the adult breakouts have gone away. I have purchased a second time because my husband and 18yr old son are also using it too. It has reduced my sons acne a lot, and my husband noticed that he doesn’t break out after shaving when he applies the fbomb immediately afterwards.

name: Joanne C.
body:
Looking for a product that moisturizes and nourishes my skin, without all the filler junk and toxic crap, F-Balm appeared as though a direct answer to my dry prayers.
I have been using this for 2 weeks now and have to say I LOVE it. I use day and night but really love how is makes me look and subsequently feel, when using it as a base under makeup.
Silky smooth, glowy but not oily and a true bonus, the company is local, Canadian and they don't subscribe to the bullshit spreading in the world today.
For their convictions, authenticity and values alone ... I'd support this company!

name: Lesley P.
body: I've been using this tallow for about a week now, and the dry psoriasis patches are almost completely gone, the rosacea bumps are at a minimum. I don't mind the redness and "rosy" glow from the rosacea, but can't wait to see if that fades as well. My skin hasn't felt this soft in a long time.

name: Janna W.
body: This has really helped with moisture in my skin it has healing benefits for redness, acne and rosacea, which I had personally struggled with I have been using this product since it had came out. Highly recommended! A little goes along way and one tin lasts for about 6 months well worth your money and time. Also they are super helpful and speedy delivery. Very well made and the sent is very nice.

name: Contelanea A.
body:
LOVE IT! I started with a small order, but everyone at my house kept taking it.
My skin is better, my heels aren’t cracked (and believe me I tried everything). I love that I know exactly what’s in it and what my skin absorbs. People don’t realize that your skin is the largest organ of the human body. All this and a real company is worth supporting. I love the fact that they supported freedom of expression, speech and Canada when it wasn’t cool to do so. Keep doing what you’re doing!

name: Patricia K.
body: I have been using F-Balm for 2 months now, and I LOVE it! It does everything it claims to do, and then some! I wash my face, then spritz with water or rose water, emulsify a small amount of F-Balm, and apply to my face, neck, and eye area! My skin has a beautiful glow, and my lines are definitely softened. I use the type with honey, and frankincense, and it is divine. I highly recommend this product! 🩷 Also, great customer support and service! Five star ⭐️ product and company!

name: Kristin H.
body: This is my second order of F-Balm. I love it. I use it as face moisturizer, and used it as lip balm and hand lotion. My skin feels firmer, less wrinkled (I am 53) and I love the way it easily absorbs in but leaves a nice soft feel. This order I added the 3 tin pack of lip balms and am thrilled to be able to have one in my truck, one in my handbag and one by my bed. I won’t use anything else!!

name: Sari L.
body: I’ve been using this balm on my surgery scar and after a week, I can tell it’s faded and less noticeable.  It’s a 3.5 inch hip replacement scar, and the balm has really made a huge difference!  I also use it on my face at night and I wake up looking smooth and refreshed. I also ordered the S-balm zinc for my face to protect me in the sun. Great products!

name: Charline R.
body:
I’ve tried countless skincare products over the years, but nothing compares to this one. From the first application, my skin felt softer, more hydrated, and noticeably smoother. After just a week, I started seeing a visible glow, and my uneven tone started evening out.
Highly recommend to anyone looking to nourish their skin and bring back that fresh, natural glow. I’ll definitely be buying this again!

body:

Or it could also be diet/breakouts due to systemic/environmental changes and not necessarily this product alone. I wouldnt use too much as well. I love the texture even if it trails on the skin. I can't wait to use this on my skin with more sunshine! I extend it to other areas like hands, elbows, arms, all the way down to the chest plate.

body: I love this product so far! I tried it by it’s self the first day and found it a bit greasy. Next day I tried it and gave it time to do it’s job on my skin and wiped the residual grease layer away. Third day I tried it over my Tree to Tub daily moisturizer once the daily moisturizer had penetrated my skin and just love the result!! The secret I find to F Balm is to use a minimal amount, as instructed, and wipe away the very thin greasy layer if you are in a hurry! I find the 2 products work very well together, the F Balm serves as the top coat sealing in the moisture and nutrients both natural products bring to the table! I’m 63, have always looked young for my age, and this regimen is definitely reducing the fine lines at the corners of my lips and tightening my upper eye lids! Very pleased with this product and will continue using. I have only been using it for 5 days and already love it!! I will be trying the S Balm once the warmer weather and summer sun arrive!

body:
I took a few days of trying the Tactical Valm before writing this review because I wanted to be sure about it.  I am up at our cottage in Muskoka rebuilding our dock, so a lot of time spent in and out of the water with an over-abundance of pesky deer flies, horse flies, and mosquitoes.  They seem to be enjoying the lack of a breeze and are out for blood.  Two weeks ago I was up here working on the dock and I was eaten alive, especially by the deer flies.  I didn’t have the Tactical Balm yet.  I don’t like spraying deet directly on my skin and it was far too hot to wear full clothing, so the flies took advantage and got their meal, me.
This time around is a far different story.  The Balm works surprisingly well!  I apply it to my arms and legs, back, chest and shoulders, face, neck and ears.  This Tactical Balm really does the trick!  The flies still buzzed around my hair so I sprayed some deet on my hat to fully keep them away.  I had to reapply the balm every hour or two because of sweat and being in and out of the water.
Very, very happy with this product!
Thank you!!
Chris Nagy

Not a single bug bite of any sort, despite hiking through mosquito infested areas and expending considerable time sitting near the lake.
I used a 'squished pea' amount to my arms and legs, and that was enough for the hike lasting just over 6 1/2 hours. Even with sweating and rubbing against the brush on the sides of the trail, the Field Balm held true.
I am now headed into the Oklahoma and Texas areas for several weeks, where there are far more ticks than I have on Vancouver Island, and my new traveling companion is the Freedom Field Balm.
The scent is very pleasant, the Balm  doesn't leave my skin greasy, but it does leave me feeling great after applying it, unlike the others I mentioned earlier.
The Freedom Field Balm is a great product, I'll definitely order more.

My skin is taking time to get used to the change. It says to use sparingly, however; I found my skin needed two applications to feel moisturized in this dry, winter climate. The thing is, everyone's skin will react differently. It's not a one fits all when it comes to skincare. It's been about 2 weeks now, and I'm finally feeling that my skin is getting used to this new skincare. I definitely want to give the face whip a good chance before I write it off as I prefer natural products overall.

Victor

name: Githa V.
body:
First let me say I love the fact that this product is Canadian made! My sister recommended this product to me so I thought I’d give it a try! And “all natural” Is a BIG draw!
I really liked the texture of this body butter and found it applied very nicely, especially after a shower. A little did not seem to go very far when using it on my full body, so I found myself using quite a bit of product each time.
Where I did love this product was on my feet. Applying it overnight with socks left my feet feeling incredibly soft and moisturized by morning. I would most likely purchase it again just for this purpose alone.
I also have several tattoos, including one that was very freshly completed, and I was impressed that the product did not irritate or aggravate my skin at all.
Overall, while I enjoyed the texture and appreciated how gentle it was on sensitive skin and tattoos, I personally did not find the moisturizing effects long-lasting enough for full body use. Considering the amount needed per application, I unfortunately felt the product was overpriced for the value received.

body: I do notice a difference at how soft and hydrated my skin feels. A little difference in wrinkles but those take years to appear so it will take time to reduce them. All of the F-Balm products have the same results! I recommend them to my family and friends!

name: Mary S.
body:

body: I have used the F-balm for about 1.5 years and my skin has never looked or felt better! body:

It’s comforting to know there are no chemicals in these products and they leave my skin feeling smooth and healthy.

name: Glennis A.
body:
Hello, I am a senior and have already used the F-Balm for a couple of months now and just love that my skin is so soft, especially in this dry winter weather.
I also ordered the facial whip recently and love that too.  It absorbs very well, you don’t need a lot, and when I wake up in the morning, my skin still feels very soft and not dry,  (I also use the soap) someone remarked that they use the soap to wash their hair, I tried it and it’s great. 👍

name: Brenda M.
body: Excellent product!!! This is the best, most natural product I have ever used in over 35 years. It is excellent on my hands and does not feel greasy. Unlike commercial hand creams that provide only brief, temporary relief.  It greatly softens the lines under my eyes and smile lines and provides a gentle, lasting barrier from the winter cold and dry heat.

name: Cheryl C.
body:
Skeptical...how could something 'so simple' be so effective for exzema-prone, cracked painful hands?  After all, I grew up on a farm and although we used most of what we grew or raised, beef tallow wasn't on the list.
I am in initial 'trials' (having tried and used so many products and prescription ointments/creams) to see if this will make a positive difference.  So far, so good...just have to accustom myself to the 'scent'.

name: Wendy H.
body: Total game changer!! In just days it took my dry worn out  skin and turned it soft healthy and supple. Even some dark spots have lightened!! I love it ❤️

name: Jason S.
body: Really liking the lip balm. I am someone who has constantly used Blistex for years now. I like Blistex but it needs to be regularly re-applied. With the Tallowed lip balm I can apply it before going to bed and in the morning my lips are still not dried out and there is still a layer of lip balm. Works well!

name: Heather W.
body: Hi I really don't use cream on my face because my eyes swell up from.the products so I started to you this and it did not bother my eyes so it's been a week it didn't get rid of the wrinkles  but the first time in years my daughter told me what r u using your face looks softer  and I was taken back because I have not heard it in a long time so I will continue with it for a month and see what happens I am glad a bought it thank you

name: Amanda W.
body:
I have suffered from contact dermatitis for nearly 9 years and all the steroid creams Vaseline coconut oil did not really help it
The F balm made my skin look normal for the first time in years so happy 😊

name: Colin T.
body: f balm is part of my daily morning and night routine. Im an active outdoor senior (65)and it has transformed my skin. No more dry spots, or enlarged brown spots. After spending years in the sun and having damaged skin, my skin finally feels and looks healthy.

name: Sara M.
body: Best thing I’ve used on my skin in years, love it.  My skin is looking great after only  a week of using and it is fabulous for protecting skin exposed to cold Alberta weather conditions. It’s like a magical balm for the dry skin from the dry cold air here.

name: Sarah H.
body: I bought the Freedom Face whip. the F-Balm, lip balm and soap and the products are just amazing! The balms are luxurious and have just the right amount of beeswax in them to keep them soft and gorgeous to apply on the skin.  The soap lathers beautifully and the Freedom balm is also so soft and smooth and creamy.  Honestly, these products are ' top notch' .  I am so happy to find such wonderful tallow balm products.  Even the thank you note and the packaging was all done with love, I could feel it.  Thank you thank you. Sarah

name: Karen K.
body: This has replaced all of my moisturizers, neck creams, and eczema products. I love it! I put it on in the shower while I’m drying off. It’s quick and easy. I haven’t had an eczema flare up since I started using it, and my skin looks better than it has in years. My neck and chest in particular are looking smooth and much less crepey. I would highly recommend!

name: Judy S.
body:
You gave me a replacement for the winter scent as it reacted with my skin. The unscented face whip that I received isn’t bothering my skin and I love its texture! It really does smell a little more beefy than I am used to ( always use the whipped body butter). Any chance you might consider making the unscented facewhip with a tiny amount of honey or beeswax to cover up the smell a little bit? I know I don’t react to either of the bee products. Just a thought!
Just going in now to replenish my body butter supply!
Have a great day😊

name: Shantel H.
body: My son and I absolutely love this! We both can see a difference in our complexion, I have a psoriasis spot on my leg that I was using organic caster oil on and it was working great! Thought I’d try the f-balm on it and it works amazing! Thank you tallowed truth.

name: Cecilia S.
body: This product makes  my skin feel moisturized. In a couple of days I noticed some wrinkles looked slightly less deep.

name: Lauren M.
body: This is my second time ordering and I absolutely love it. I had winter dryness and its gone after one use. I love the smell and texture, too.  I'm also excited to see the long-term results. I love the image on the tin! I highly recommend it! Thank you!!

name: Sherrin N.
body: After day 1 I noticed a difference in my skin. Softer, smoother, hydrated. It has helped my dry lips as well!

name: Karen W.
body: When I received my second tin of F balm I noticed it smelled a little beefier than my first. When questioned if the formula had changed or there was some mix up I had absolutely the best customer service! A replacement tin was sent asap and it is amazing. Love the natural recipe and all Canadian company. I’m 57 going on 45? Love sharing my simple routine with my pals. Keep up the great work!

name: Anna H.
body: Dearest Ben and  F Balm Family, Thank you for the great products again. Love the hat!!!! Spending a month in Florida and are keeping healed in the sun by your products. Love them and share them with all we meet :) Might have more customers :). Thank you!!!

name: Carol C.

I have now ordered the S-Balm and am hopeful that will work for me too, as I have spent a fortune trying to find a sunscreen that my face doesn’t react to. I wish I had discovered this 10 years ago. Will definitely buy multiple and save, on my next order.

name: Kim D.
body: I love how soft and smooth this makes my skin! My turkey neck is almost gone and I burned my finger with hot water and used this and BAM, no more burn! Love this stuff!

name: Sofia S.
body:

name: Bernadet L.
body: It’s the only thing that worked for my daughter’s eczema! I tried everything, spent a lot on expensive creams and treatments that don’t work. I’m so glad I tried F-Balm! Now my daughter’s skin is getting better.

name: Virginia A.
body:
I bought the scented one first, and broke out in whiteheads within a week. The unscented one was recommended to me by Heather, (who was wonderful) she sent me one free of charge to try. Virginia

name: Sarah A.
body: As soon my parcel arrived and before I even opened it I caught a lovely scent of the citrus and lavender bars as I ordered a variety to start. name: Denise R.
body: This ointment is exceptional. I use it on my hands and lips as they are very dry. It keeps them soft which is great. I would recommend this to anyone that needs to rectify dry skin. My skin is super sensitive and I'm allergic to many products, but this one did not affect me in any way except in a positive way by making my skin feel wonderful.

name: Pam W.
body:
I first saw the adds with, I am guessing with Ben, on Instagram and thought the take on the advertising was hilarious. My daughter has been using tallow for years from a small company on Vancouver Island.  Anyway a few weeks in and I have replaced all my other products.  I will buy again.
Pam Williams

name: Elizabeth W.
body: My feet are just nasty.  I've been using this after soaking these puppies.  Then putting on socks...it's made a world of difference.   The scent is great.  When my feet are warm, from soaking in hot water, it melts like butter.  Great product.  Thanks you guys.

name: Nina C.
body: I love it so much I gave a container to my sister who is 11 years younger her than me but has more wrinkles to try it I’m noticing a visual difference on the fine lines around my mouth and I’ve only been using it for a week so I’m impressed good stuff

name: Carol F.
body: I've  been using the Tallow for over two weeks at night, and I am noticing subtle differences in my skin.  Looking forward to seeing the results after a month or so.

name: Kelli W.
body: This product is easy and simple to use which is very nice if you have a busy schedule.  I suggest to avoid over use which may cause a greasy look, place a small amount into your palm and rub it to melt then apply as needed..this will help you regulate the amount you need.  The scent of the tallow can be a bit over powering. The tallow scent does fade in time, however others too can smell it so I would suggest that what is used to mask the tallow sent be upped a bit more.  In saying all this…while I put it on in the morning my skin feels hydrated throughout the day up to when washing my face before sleep.  I would recommend this product to others and will reorder when the time comes.

name: Gillian S.
body: My daughter actually gave me my first tin of F-balm and I have used every day since. I was at my Mother-in-law’s and she said she couldn’t believe how smooth the skin on my forehead was and asked what I was used! I immediately ordered 3 tins to get the deal and gave one to her. I love the smell of the frankincense too. Makes it seem like a spa and giving myself a little treat every day.

name: Cara C.
body: Absolutely love the F-Bomb Tallow Balm. The light scent of honey and frankincense is delightful! A little goes a long way! I have normal/combination skin and my skin is loving it! Absolutely recommend this!!

name: Elaine L.

name: Sharon C.
body: I’ve been on this earth for 71 years. I have tried more skin care products than I can count. It goes on smoothly and gives my skin a healthy glow. I use it twice a day and will continue to use it.

name: Sylvie M.
body:
Well - I'm hooked. I bought this on a whim and now I’m convinced it should come with a warning label:
“May cause excessive cheek touching and unsolicited compliments.”

So I lathered on some  F-balm and it took away the flaky look and moisturized her dehydrated skin. Definitely recommend!

body:
Hi,
I’m so sorry but I have to be honest about how I feel about this product, and unfortunately, it wasn’t great!

I have tried many different brands of tallow, I even bought a friends (no longer making it) and never have I ever smelt beef!

our_reply:
Hi there, great question! Right after you wash your face at night/morning, barely dry it. While it's still damp-somewhat wet, take less than a pea-sized amount of product, melt it in your hands, and massage it into your damp skin.
If you're feeling greasy or sticky, it usually means you're using too much or need a bit more water. The Balm really goes a long way so only a tiny tiny bit is needed for the face! Start with less and add more as needed. I hope this helps. Feel free to email into support for further help :)
